gen-gf-autour-one-gf-maven-pro: Expressive and a little show-off, Autour One leads with round letters that slide in without any hairline-to-stem shift. Maven Pro follows with a gentle, uniform line and a lowercase that stands tall.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-michroma: Bold shapes, wide stance: Michroma gives each letter generous room and a tall lowercase, while Autour One flows smoothly into its rounds. The heading earns its place when it's big and short.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-miriam-libre: Miriam Libre draws a wire-thin line with generous openings in its s, while Autour One adds round, expressive heft above. Shrink the heading and its bold character fades fast.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-mochiy-pop-one: Autour One comes in bold, with round letters that flow right in. Mochiy Pop One does the quieter job, its big lowercase eyes and widely hung letters carrying text where the heading makes the statement.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Mochiy Pop P One reads wide and friendly, with generous gaps and a sizable lowercase, under Autour One's bold rounds. Loud heading, soft-spoken body, and no brush-like swelling anywhere.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-montserrat-underlin: Expressive heading, steady body, clearly set apart. Autour One brings bold, round-letter punch while Montserrat Underline keeps uniform bowls and an oversized lowercase, and their distance is the appeal.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-mozilla-headline: Mozilla Headline offers big-bodied lowercase and a splayed c terminal beneath Autour One's bold, thick-only outlines. And paragraphs in it should feel open, approachable and easy going, line after line.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-mozilla-text: Autour One draws round letters with no hairline-to-stem shift at all. It handles the loud, bold statement, while Mozilla Text handles the reading, its tall bodies and flared terminals keeping text sturdy.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-nata-sans: Nata Sans reads steady and clean, with a large central band and curves that leave their mouths unclosed. Autour One supplies the loud, rounded opening act; Nata Sans carries on.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-nobile: Round, bold, unbroken: Autour One's curves match its stems, while Nobile keeps its x-height close to its caps. Smooth curves are the shared strength, with nothing fighting anything.
